best: Small sheets (3V3, MCU, pack power path) are clean, titled blocks with helpful notes, and the four-switch power stage reads as a textbook H-bridge with L401 between SW1/SW2.
worst: BQ25756 charger block fans every pin out on long parallel staircase wires ending in stub labels (HIDRV1, SW1, LODRV2...) so the gate-drive and sense loops must be traced by name rather than seen

Text collisions on USB and Cells sheets: C412/C413 values overlap SW1/SW2 labels, R410 value sits on ACOV wire, TH101/TH104 values overlap the thermistor symbols, TPS25751 bottom pin numbers stacked illegibly

Gauge cell-sense inputs route via long nested wires around U101 and power is split across sheets by labels (PACK_P bulk on 3V3 sheet, 5V buck and 9V supply as small boxes with large empty area between USB sections)
